items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ken Kimery is identified in the transcript notes as the engineer ('with Ken Kimery') and is not mentioned in any conversational turn describing a personal or professional relationship with McCoy Tyner.

ctx.x: Really? I haven’t seen Curtis in a while. So he’s living here? That’s good, I might give him a call one day. Kimery: I have his number.
Yeah I appreciate that, just to say hi. We go way back, that would be nice. I think I saw him once since he has been in town, but it’s been a while so I’d like to.
